note: All four OLBG matches are Irish club county championship finals. Fixtures verified against official county board / provincial sources (Cork GAA gaacork.ie, Munster GAA, Galway GAA); semi-final scores from official results listings and match reports. One OLBG listing carries a wrong date (flagged).
model: Simple stated margin model for county finals: expected margin m (points) built from verified knockout-stage winning margins (capped at 15 points per game to limit blowout distortion), averaged per team, halved, plus +1 point for a reigning county champion. Margin ~ Normal(m, SD 8). 3-way line (win/draw/win) and points handicap (= -m rounded to nearest half point) derived from that distribution; draw probability is the Normal mass on margin 0 (finals level after 60 minutes go to replay/extra time per competition rules - the draw price refers to the 60-minute result, as OLBG lists a 3-way market). Confidence capped at medium: verified sample is only 1-3 knockout games per club. No totals market originated (OLBG lists no totals market for Gaelic football in our capture, and scoring-environment data is too thin).

Kanturk: SF 11 Oct: beat Carbery Rangers after extra time (came from behind twice; forced ET late)
